explanation: The sharp clap gives the editor one frame and one sound spike to line up. The writing on the board labels the scene and take.

claims.text: The clapperboard's clap lets editors synchronize separately recorded sound with the picture.
Setting focus, checking the lighting and counting frames are not the clapperboard's main job.
The clap gives the editor a single frame and a sharp sound spike to line up in the edit.
Writing on the clapperboard identifies the scene and take.
